hint.owner_only: Only the company owner can change it.
hint.unmanageable_holder: Someone you cannot manage has this role.
hint.limit: You can create at most {{count}} custom roles.

roles.restoreBody: A restored role comes back with its default name and permissions.

drawer.pickTitle: Where do you want to start?
drawer.pickBody: Pick a template. In the next step you can review and change the permissions.
drawer.blankDesc: Starts with no permissions; you choose.
drawer.name: Role name
drawer.lockedBanner: This is the company owner's role: its permissions are locked; only its name and description can change.
drawer.dropped_one: {{count}} permission from the template was left out: only the company owner can give it, or you do not have it.
drawer.dropped_other: {{count}} permissions from the template were left out: only the company owner can give them, or you do not have them.
drawer.autoLegend: Faded tick: added automatically because another permission needs it.
drawer.limitReached: This tool can have at most {{count}} custom roles. Delete a role you do not use to add a new one.
drawer.liveNote: When you save, open sessions of people with this role refresh with the new permissions within seconds.

block.owner_only: Only the company owner can give this permission.
block.escalation: You cannot add a permission you do not have yourself.
block.dependency: It needs “{{perm}}”, which you cannot give.

issue.tooLong: The role name can be at most {{max}} characters.
issue.taken: A role with this name already exists. Choose another name.
issue.descriptionTooLong: The description can be at most {{max}} characters.

error.version: Someone else changed this role while you were editing it. Load the latest version and try again.
error.invalidPerms: Some permissions need other permissions too: {{list}}.

forbidden.escalation: You cannot add a permission you do not have yourself.
forbidden.owner_only: Only the company owner can give this permission.
forbidden.unmanageable_holder: Someone you cannot manage uses this role (you, the company owner or a company admin).
forbidden.other: You do not have permission to change this role this way.
forbidden.pending_admin_invites: This role has pending invitations sent by a company admin. Cancel those invitations or resend them yourself first.

error.pendingInvites: This role has pending invitations sent by a company admin: {{list}}. Cancel them or resend them yourself from the invitations on the Team page, then try again.
error.limit: This tool already has the maximum number of custom roles. Delete a role you do not use.
error.locked: This role cannot be deleted and its permissions cannot be changed. Only its name can.
error.inUse: Someone was given this role in the meantime. Choose the new role before deleting it.

done.reset: The {{name}} role was reset to default.

reset.title: Reset “{{name}}” to default?
reset.body: The role's name and permissions go back to the built-in version. The change applies right away to everyone with this role.

delete.title: Delete the “{{name}}” role?
delete.inUseBoth: This role is assigned to {{members}} and {{invites}}. Before deleting it, choose the role they will get instead.
delete.inUseOne: This role is assigned to {{what}}. Before deleting it, choose the role they will get instead.
delete.noTarget: There is no other role to move them to. Create a new role first.
delete.sessions: The change applies right away; open sessions refresh with the new permissions within seconds.
delete.builtinNote: The built-in role is removed from your company; you can bring it back with “Restore deleted built-in roles”.
